title: Pedro II's End Update
description: This Minecraft mod adds the End Update to the game with 3 new biomes, 3 new structures, 1 mob, and 2 powerful weapon.
body:
Transform your End dimension into a brand-new adventure!

This mod completely revamps the End by adding exciting new content to explore. Discover 2 unique biomes, each with its own atmosphere, terrain, and blocks. Venture into 2 mysterious structures filled with secrets and valuable loot, encounter a new hostile mob lurking in the void, and forge a powerful new weapon to survive the dangers ahead.

Whether you're looking for fresh exploration, new challenges, or simply a more immersive End experience, this mod expands the dimension while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel.

Features:

🌌 3 unique End biomes
🏛️ 3 new structures to discover
👾 2 new mob
⚔️ 2 powerful new weapon
🟣 New blocks, decorations, and resources

The End is no longer empty... are you ready to explore it?
